notes.title: The Top of The Dream - Comprehensive Update - Ver1.1.0
notes.content:
[i]This is not a dream that can be easily given up[/i]

It has been three years since the release of 《The Top of The Dream》. Thank you all for your understanding and support of this work.
We are well aware of our lack of experience and technical skills, may not be able to produce TouHou-Doujin-STG that are acceptable to everyone.
During this period, we also collected a large amount of feedback from players, conducted multiple tests, and attempted to continuously add and optimize content.
With the establishment of new update milestones, the music production for all Stages has also been successfully completed.
Sorry for not being able to provide players with the gaming experience they should have had when the game was first released,
If you play the game again, you may be notice our efforts.

[i]If this is our first time meeting[/i]

[h2] Music update [/h2]
* Added 15 in-game BGM
* Optimized the performance effect of the audio system

[h3] Art Update [/h3]
* Improved the clarity of in-game textures
* Recreate some visual effects of art resources
* Recreate some character portraits
* Recreate some scenes

[h3] Text adjustment [/h3]
* Adjust the teaching level text
* Optimized character dialogue text

[h3] Level optimization [/h3]
* Difficulty adjustment, redesigned some level bullet screens
* Adjusted and optimized some spellcard difficulty and first-time encounter difficulty
* Added mocking dialogue when encountering spellcards
* Increased the number of enemies, reduced their health and shield time
* Optimized the problem of difficulty in seeing bullet screens in some environments

[h3] New system [/h3]
* Added drop handling system
* Added Differential Convergence (DC) gameplay mode: You can enter the story from any level node on the main interface

[h3] System optimization and adjustment [/h3]
* Adjusted firepower/alertness system
* Adjusted the barrier mechanism
* Optimized the tracking bullet effect
* Adjust Ex unlocking conditions to: clear Stage 6 in any mode
* Function disabled: Hidden functions such as debugging, cheating, and skipping have been disabled

[h3] UI optimization [/h3]
* The game interface has added a numerical display of firepower values
* Adjusted some UI aesthetics and contrast of the game interface
* Adjusted some guidance interfaces in the game interface
* Optimized some text prompt effects and font art in the game interface

[h3] BUG fix [/h3]
* Fixed the issue of semi transparent character portraits during conversations
* Fixed some spellcard abnormal issues


[i]Ver1.1.0[/i]

notes.title: Preview: The Top of The Dream free to play
notes.content:
[h1][b]summary[/b][/h1]
According to the feedback of the players, the finish and quality of the game didn't meet the expectations of the players, but also brought a bad game experience to many people,
So we decided to make the game free to play.
Here are the heartfelt thanks to the players who have given this feedback to the game.
We will listen to each of your opinions, continue the optimization of the game, give all the players a better game experience!
Will be updated in the week after the announcement (not to exclude the delay of the for special reasons).

[h3]Price adjustment[/h3]
The price of the game has been changed to free forever!
[h3]Game difficulty adjustment[/h3]
Will reduce the difficulty of each level and initial kill!
[h3]UI Optimize and update[/h3]
Adjust the part of the UI that directly affects the player's experience!

[h3]Subsequent updates[/h3]
We will beautify the UI more and start making and updating the music from 1 to 6 sides, as well as optimizing for the bullet screen design step by step.
